title: Asterweave context manifest
description: Bounded repository context produced by the analyze node and reused by downstream graph nodes instead of re-scanning the repository. Transient workflow state, not a committed artifact.

rules.description: Repository-relative paths to CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md, or other instructions applicable to this task.

specs.description: Repository-relative paths to specs/** documents applicable to this task, when specs exist.

representativeFiles.description: Existing implementations whose patterns should be reused.

tests.description: Existing tests covering the affected behavior.

affectedPaths.description: Modules/directories the change is expected to touch.
